messages:
Anya (devex): heads-up — planning to enable the client-side header gate `compact-headers` for SDKs >= 2.4 as a canary tonight at 22:00 PT. Canary scope: 10% mobile, 5% web. Need quick sign-off on telemetry, rollout gates, and rollback criteria.
Mike H.: ok from me if fallback is safe. older clients shouldn't send the header and should behave the same. confirm how SDK encodes it?
Maria (sdk): confirmed — SDK will only send `x-redwood-compact: 1` for versions >=2.4 when feature is enabled by the feature flag. Older SDKs send nothing. we also support `x-redwood-compact: forced-off` to force disable for testing.
Leo (eng-runtime): runtime will ignore unknown headers. please ensure we add a metric and trace tag for this header so we can slice latency/errors by header presence. suggest: `redwood.client.header.compact_enabled` counter + `redwood.client.header.client_version` tag.
Maria (sdk): small snippet we'll ship in the SDK:
```js
// pseudo
if (semver.gte(clientVersion, '2.4.0') && featureToggleEnabled) {
  req.headers['x-redwood-compact'] = '1';
}
```
Maria (sdk): also adding a unit test for serialization and a e2e smoke test for a request with/without header.
Anya (devex): QA checklist I'm expecting before flip: perf baseline, synthetic load against canary pool, p50/p95 latency comparison, error-rate monitor, and a small regression prompt set run. Maria pls add the smoke to the SDK CI job.
Mike H.: who is watching the canary live? assign a primary + backup for 60 minutes after rollout. If error rate >0.5% or latency p95 regress >15% we roll back.
Leo (eng-runtime): I'll be primary for runtime metrics, @Mike H. can be backup. I'll add an automatic rollback rule in the router: if 5m error rate spike or sustained latency regress, disable header route.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy by Anya (id:deploy-194765) at 22:00 PT — targets: canary-pool-3 (10% mobile), canary-pool-4 (5% web).
Anya (devex): I'll post the rollout notice in #general and notify on-call. Also will open a short dashboard with these cards: p50/p95 tokens, errors, header-enabled ratio, and SDK version breakdown.
Maria (sdk): PR ready: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/482 — includes header flag, tests, and changelog note. pinged @Mike H. and @Leo for review.
Mike H.: LGTM on the approach. Maria, make sure metrics include `sdk_version` and `platform` tags so we can filter mobile vs web easily.
Anya (devex): one more guardrail — keep header payload < 32 bytes. we had a proxy trimming issue last quarter when headers were large.
Leo (eng-runtime): noted, I'll add a header-size check in the ingress path and drop/metric when >64 bytes so we can see problematic clients.
Maria (sdk): will enforce max 16 chars for header value and add a serializer test.
Mike H.: after canary, if stable for 1 hour we'll expand to 50% mobile and 20% web. rollback plan: flip feature flag off in runtime and cut a patch release if we detect client-side regressions.
Anya (devex): thanks team. I'll coordinate the watch rotation and post a follow-up update 30m into canary. Please react here with :thumbsup: if you're good.
Mike H.: :thumbsup:
Leo (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:
Maria (sdk): :thumbsup:
